The booking sites at Las Vegas hotels

58 sites, 10 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Hotels.com at 17, CheapTickets.com at 15 and Expedia.com at 15. Fewest sites: W Las Vegas (16); most: The STRAT Hotel, Casino & Tower (28, as were 6 others).

Hotels.com was lowest at none of its 17, and 5%+ above another site at 17. CheapTickets.com was lowest at none of its 15, and 5%+ above another site at 15. Expedia.com was lowest at none of its 15, and 5%+ above another site at 15.

The hotel's own site, at 14 of the 17: lowest at none, a median 46% above the lowest site. Nearest: The Venetian Las Vegas, $499 against $435 on Super.com. Farthest: Rio Hotel & Casino, $257 against $118 on Vio.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 7, KAYAK.com at 4, Hotelscombined.com at 3, Vio.com at 3, Etrip.net at 2, goseek.com at 2, Hotels In America at 2, Best Hotel Deals at 1 and momondo.com at 1 (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate. Up to 28 listings were kept per hotel.

Taxes, fees and resort fees in Las Vegas

They added a median of 13.4% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It was 12.0% to 13.8% at all 14 hotels, from The STRAT Hotel, Casino & Tower to The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas: no flat nightly fee on top. Whether a resort fee was inside the before-tax price, our data cannot tell. The 3 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: do resort fees show in the price?

Las Vegas, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Las Vegas hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 8 up, 2 down of 10; rose most Planet Hollywood Las Vegas Resort & Casino, $85 to $148; fell most Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino, $203 to $131; another site lowest at 7.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 8 up, 9 down of 17; rose most Park MGM Las Vegas, $180 to $265; fell most Luxor Hotel & Casino, $116 to $96; another site lowest at 13.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about Las Vegas hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Las Vegas?

$196 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $84 at The STRAT Hotel, Casino & Tower to $500 at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas.

Do Las Vegas hotel prices include resort fees?

Our data cannot show a resort fee by itself. It was 12.0% to 13.8% at all 14 hotels, from The STRAT Hotel, Casino & Tower to The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas: no flat nightly fee on top. Whether a resort fee was inside the before-tax price, our data cannot tell.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Las Vegas?

No: these prices come from a few Las Vegas dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 8 Las Vegas hotels rose more than 2%, 9 fell; Park MGM Las Vegas rose most, $180 to $265 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Las Vegas hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (7 hotels) and KAYAK.com (4 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 14.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.

Nearest medians to Las Vegas's: New York $191, Miami $225, Cancun $233, Orlando $145.
